queries_run: DexCom China tariff OR export control OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 列示關稅與貿易政策波動（含更高進口關稅、報復性關稅）與 OFAC／BIS 出口管制為國際營運風險因子；屬一般性風險揭露，未量化
findings.excerpt: fluctuations in trade policy and tariff regulations, including potential higher tariffs on imported goods and materials and renegotiation of free trade agreements and potential retaliatory tariffs imposed by foreign countries against U.S. goods

findings.claim: 2026 年搜尋未見 DexCom 專屬的關稅或出口管制量化影響；2026 Q3 non-GAAP 毛利率 65.1%（去年同期 61.3%），全年指引約 64%
findings.excerpt: Non-GAAP gross profit* totaled $875.3 million or 65.1% of reported revenue for the third quarter of 2026

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋摘要僅見 2025 年 Q2 毛利率受關稅影響之提及，2026 無量化；未見 DexCom 被列入實體清單或中國貿易限制之來源。
